conclusion: A new dynamic shared reservation owner is NOT logically necessary for a first isolated test if a fresh process-bound hard upper envelope of all possible additional physical and commit demand fits for the entire interval. Historical source supplies finite configured VM-memory accounting pools, but not a complete host physical/commit bound. No current fit determination is possible; retain P/E/O unknown.

formula.simple: For each manager i with verified enforced VM reservation cap C_i, use C_i in full if actual reflected allocation is unknown. With proven same-epoch H_i (all held reservations) and U_i (not-yet-reflected portion), use max(0,C_i-H_i)+U_i; add any outside-ledger/router pending conservatively. This covers inflight plus future admitted VMs, not waiting queue count.
formula.reflectedEquivalent: C_i - R_i where R_i is the proven already-reflected part; removals/replacements must preserve the net bound and only release ledger after actual stop. Do not deduct historical health allocations as if all physically reflected.
formula.physicalRequirement: Fresh F >= live floor max(18432,higher) + sum VM future/unreflected maxima + independently bounded pre-admission/helper/host/kernel physical demand + actual test/observer/creator/early budgets.
formula.commitRequirement: Independent fresh available commit >= proven worst incremental VM/host/helper commit + test/observer/creator/early commitments. Configured VM physical MiB is not itself a verified system-commit upper bound.
formula.coverage: Stable source/config/manager incarnation and no uncovered direct/administrative allocators or reconfiguration during the finite interval. Pressure sampling complements, does not establish, the bound.

illustrativeOnly.excluded: Other overhead, creator, unqualifiedE/O, commit. Historical observations are not simultaneous/current; this is arithmetic, NOT admission or current impossibility proof.

missingHardBounds.gap: Direct HTTP spawn accumulates body chunks without aggregate admission slots/bytes, then fetchComponent occurs before VM pool reservation. Finite VM pools therefore do not bound concurrent host request/fetch memory.
Per-fetch bytes/timeout/output limits exist, but no aggregate simultaneous fetch/process memory/commit cap is demonstrated. Failure before VM reservation can still consume host resources.
PowerShell runner has bounded output/time and honest unresolved child tracking, not Job/RSS/commit cap. VM pool excludes these allocations and potentially unresolved child footprint.
Relay child/process and buffers are not covered by VM physical-memory cap; existing and future helper growth must be independently bounded.

Hyper-V worker/kernel/page-table overhead and relation between configured VM physicalMiB and system commit are not bounded by current historical evidence. Other host processes/admin launch paths are uncovered.

neededToUseShortcut: Fresh independently bound resident source/config for each manager, non-null finite cap and actual native-wrapper constraints; both full inventories and router durable head correlated with OS reflection.

A hard or otherwise independently justified interval-wide upper bound for every non-VM allocator including direct pre-admission requests/fetches/helper processes, other host work and creator/test E/O; no missing term set to zero.
Fresh physical AND commit measurements; arithmetic proves the complete potential envelope fits while keeping>=live floor. Current pool figures alone cannot produce this proof.

If full proven envelope fits, first qualification need not wait for dynamic shared-owner installation. If it does not fit, use an actually effective admission-only allocation boundary or more available capacity; do not stop current serving VMs.
